assets.name: pause
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one small Elsewhere game UI pictogram, named pause. Subject: two upright rounded gold pause pillars, separated by a clear narrow gap. Style: clean hand-painted cartoon game icon, subtle dimensional shading, crisp thick deep navy outline, warm cream and amber highlights, same welcoming polished style as a cartoon axe tool icon. Composition: ONLY the symbol, centered, front view, occupying 80% of square canvas, readable at 24 pixels. Background fully transparent.
